noun_definition: android refers to the mobile operating system used on devices like the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold, which affects how the "Workspaces" title is displayed based on font size settings.
Workspaces refers to a section within the New Expensify app where users can manage their account settings related to different collaborative environments or projects.

Workspaces title refers to the header displayed in the Workspaces section of the New Expensify app, which is expected to appear on a single line but is currently shown on two lines under certain conditions.
